categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jinling Sports Equipment Co., Ltd primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of sports equipment and venue facilities. Its main product lines include ball sports equipment (basketball, football, volleyball, tennis, badminton, handball), athletics equipment (high jump stands, hurdles, obstacle frames), venue facilities (stadium seats, mobile stands, plastic tracks), and sports event services such as equipment rental and event information systems. The company also engages in sports culture facility system integration and sports resource integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated and intelligent production lines, especially for high-end basketball equipment. It focuses on new materials, digital technologies, and smart equipment development. The production methods include batch production for standard products and customized production for venue facilities. Quality control is rigorous, adhering to ISO9001 and ISO14001 standards, with continuous R&D investment in new materials, technologies, applications, and processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government and public institutions, schools, sports event organizations, and sports venues. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and growing overseas sales. It supplies equipment for major sports events such as the Olympics, Asian Games, CBA basketball league, and international competitions, reflecting its focus on professional and institutional clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu Province. It also has subsidiaries in Zhejiang, Shanghai, Suzhou, and Hainan. While domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 94% of revenue, the company is actively expanding its international market presence, with exports accounting for about 5% of sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Jinling Sports Equipment operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of sports equipment and venue facilities. It procures raw materials such as steel, plastic, castings, and hardware from upstream suppliers and sells finished products directly or through distributors to downstream customers including institutions and event organizers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on smart, multifunctional, and entertainment-integrated sports equipment. It invests in new materials, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing processes. Strategic R&D projects include smart basketball racks, modular and lightweight protective cages, and advanced glass defect detection technologies. The company also emphasizes brand building, market expansion, and digital transformation to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of sports equipment and venue facilities, including direct sales to end users and sales through distributors. Additional revenue streams include sports event services such as equipment rental and event information system services, as well as venue operation income. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Jinling Sports Equipment is a leading domestic player in the high-end sports equipment manufacturing industry in China. It holds official certifications from international sports federations and is a preferred supplier for major sports events. The industry is fragmented with many small and medium enterprises, but Jinling maintains a competitive edge through brand reputation, technical certifications, and comprehensive product offerings. It faces competition primarily in the mid to low-end market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 373.6 million, a 27.3% decrease from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 26.76 million, down 60.4%. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.3 billion with net assets of RMB 822.6 million. The company experienced a decline in sales volume and revenue in several product lines but continues to invest in R&D and infrastructure. It maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing efforts to improve profitability and market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Jinling Sports Equipment emphasizes its strong brand reputation, technical certifications from international sports federations, and high product quality. Its products are recognized for meeting stringent quality standards required by professional sports events and institutional customers. The company differentiates itself through continuous innovation, smart and modular product designs, comprehensive after-sales services, and the ability to supply integrated sports culture facility solutions, positioning itself as a trusted and leading supplier in the sports equipment industry.
